profile.headline: Engineering Leader @ Skylight
profile.summary: Technology is constantly changing. What lasts is company culture that is fun, challenging, and growth-minded. As a leader in an established yet forward-looking product development organization, I am an integral part of a team-based environment propelled by creativity, collaboration, and agility. I foster a culture of empowerment and clarity by growing leadership, encouraging questions, seeking to understand, and building camaraderie while working remotely with diverse teams. Ultimately my focus is to build an environment that I’d want to work in and be a part of.

positions.title: Senior Director of Technology
positions.description:
* Lead a practice of 100+ Engineers, promoting productivity, technical excellence, and an empowered culture of collaboration
* Developed and implemented the Engineering Career Ladder, aligning expectations
with performance culture
* Established and socialized the company-wide framework for Delivery Excellence reporting
* Drove technical strategy for major federal, state, and local opportunities, including solution architecture and strategic planning
* Lead AWS Partnership Transformation Program to achieve Select Partner status through certifications, deal registrations, and strategic collateral

positions.title: VP Product Development and Operations
positions.description:
• Manage a global team of 200+ software and QA engineers in the product development and daily operations of multiple SaaS-based insurance/securities licensing and compliance solutions.
• Drive consistency in practice between locations; help scale an Agile transition with a self-sustaining process and continuous improvement culture.
• Maintain relationships with customers who are actively using the software, including Top 100 insurance carriers, Top 10 broker-dealer, and large state governments. 
• Lead development of a cloud-enabled micro services platform using containerized services (Kubernetes), event-driven architecture (Kafka), and includes data warehouse capabilities (Postgres).
• Foster a culture of empowerment by growing leaders, providing transparency, and building camaraderie within teams.

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description:
• Led multiple cross-functional teams in the design and development of an enterprise
microservice-based platform to serve the insurance and securities industries.
• Collaborated with Product Management on identifying business priorities, developing XD prototype that clarified the platform vision, and developed the technical roadmap. 
• Visited customers to gather requirements, answer RFPs and present on product technical vision. 
• Led the continuous improvement of security best practices within the SDLC by building a specialized development team that provides scale to the development department.

positions.title: Sr. Development Manager
positions.description:
• Led cross-functional teams in the design and development of enterprise products for the insurance and securities industries.
• Managed offshore development teams and contributed to the development of strategic product roadmaps.
•  Oversaw the evolution of offshore development from waterfall to agile processes, increasing productivity by 105%. 
• Led evaluation for direction of new platform development to consolidate the product portfolio.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Team Lead)
positions.description:
• Lead systems developer on a J2EE-based licensing system designed for state government use. 
• Product development, mentored other developers, performed code-reviews, and managed an outsourced development team. 
• Coordinated with an off-site partner who was responsible for requirements and QA for the system.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Web developer on key Sircon products: Compliance Express and Sircon for States. 
• Helped lead the way in converting Compliance Express from a PowerBuilder web application to a J2EE solution. 
• Participated in the earliest design and development of Sircon for States, a J2EE replacement for COSMOS. 
• Performed peer code reviews, mentored junior developers, and established code conventions and standards.
positions.insights: Computer Science, System Performance and +1 skill

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
• PL/SQL developer and served as a database administrator on the team. 
• Designed, developed, implemented, and enhanced a PowerBuilder 6.5 state insurance regulatory system, COSMOS. 
• Performed database administration functions for the support of the COSMOS system for the state insurance regulatory departments in Arkansas, California, Colorado, Indiana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wyoming. 
• Assisted in the data conversion for Pennsylvania, California, Colorado, Ohio, Indiana and Wyoming insurance departments.
